database: fortress_test (separate PostgreSQL database, truncated before every test)

tests.name: [G01] genesis is a pure function of the manifest (same input, same block)
[G01] canonical JSON is order-independent and rejects floats that are not finite
[G03] a modified block breaks chain verification
[G03] index gaps, predecessor mismatches and unsupported canonicalization versions are rejected
[G04] a checkpoint over the original chain rejects a rewritten chain
[P2-4] English and Spanish catalogs have the same IDs and placeholders
[P3-3] revocation CRDT merge is commutative, idempotent and never un-revokes
[P4-1] JSON-LD is canonicalized with RDFC-1.0 independent of key order
[P4-1] remote JSON-LD contexts are never fetched
[P5-1] anchor commitments contain only hashes and a height
[G12] random 32-byte key material never appears in canonical ledger meta helpers
[G01] a fresh tenant starts with the deterministic expected genesis
[G02][P5-2] boot reaches READY with all network access blocked and no Solana
[G03] a tampered block fails closed: verify rejects, readiness is RECOVERY_REQUIRED, writes pause
[G04] a fully rewritten, self-consistent ledger is caught by the signed checkpoint
[G05] concurrent commits never duplicate or lose a block
[G06] replaying a request with the same idempotency key does not mutate twice
[G07] the JSONL outbox export resumes safely after a crash mid-write and rebuilds a lost archive
[G08] lost device: a saved recovery code restores control and data stays decryptable
[G09] stolen device: other sessions and every API credential are revoked
[G10] ransomware drill: a .pfr package verifies and decrypts offline with only the verifier
[G11] a bad backup is rejected at restore and the source is never overwritten
[G12] secret scan: no recovery key, code, credential, KEK or plaintext is stored or archived
[G14] safe mode: suppressed notices, no notice to removed contacts, no tracking columns
[G09] provider failure is reported, never claimed as success; the local block holds and a retry finishes it
[G06] one-time secrets are never re-issued or replayed for the same idempotency key
[G02][G03] until startup verification succeeds, readiness is NOT_READY and writes are refused
[G05] verification running alongside concurrent commits never reports false tampering
[G03] resolve clears a condition only when its own check passes
[P2-1] contact recovery needs the quorum and the waiting period; the owner can cancel
[P2-2] every consent-gated action is refused until granted and again after withdrawal
[P2-3] evidence is encrypted at rest, readable by the owner, and crypto-shredded on delete
[P2-4] notifications store only message IDs and render in English or Spanish
[P3-1] witness countersignatures are accepted only from registered witness keys
[P3-2] importing an external checkpoint detects contradiction and rollback
[P2-2] consent withdrawn mid-flow is rechecked when the action commits
[P3-3] merging a peer's revocations revokes locally and can never re-grant
[P4-1] JSON-LD import commits the RDFC-1.0 digest and refuses remote contexts
[P4-2] Seamcraft envelopes need consent, a registered signed sender, the right recipient and a fresh nonce
[P4-3] JUSCR ingest through a write-only credential is idempotent and cannot read
[P5-1] anchors need consent, carry only hashes and record a transaction without network
